dependencies.scope: Klipot presents a local mirror of the canonical SAMBU registry; it is not a firmware or SAMBU runtime dependency.

boundaries: Browser labs simulate API concepts and do not execute embedded C code or access real hardware.
The portal does not control firmware, production fixtures, or device state.
Each project retains its own release, tests, and safety authority.

verification.host_tests: Static asset and Pages workflow checks are documented; run the portal validation workflow.
verification.target_validation: Not applicable to the static portal; embedded target validation belongs to the relevant module.
